title: Cruz Azul vs Toluca: Reunion After Heated Exchange with Coach
seoTitle: Cruz Azul vs Toluca: Reunion After Heated Exchange with.
subtitle: Matchday 10 Rekindles the Clash Between Katía Itzel García and Antonio “Turco” Mohamed
excerpt: The Matchday 10 clash between Cruz Azul and Toluca revives the confrontation between referee Katía Itzel García and coach Antonio “Turco” Mohamed.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The confrontation between Cruz Azul and Toluca, scheduled for Matchday 10 of Apertura 2026, brings back the tension between referee Katía Itzel García and coach Antonio “Turco” Mohamed. The reunion comes after the incident recorded in the technical area of the Nemesio Diez Stadium, when both confronted each other during the Toluca vs Atlas match.

The Incident in the Technical Area

During Matchday 8, when Toluca faced Atlas, Katía Itzel García was acting as the fourth official. Around the 12th minute, coach Mohamed approached the purple technical area to complain, leading to a visual confrontation with the referee. There was no known public sanction or subsequent statements from either party involved.

Match Outcome

Shortly after the encounter, Toluca turned the game around and defeated Atlas 5-2, pushing the incident to the background. The result secured three points for Toluca and strengthened their leading position in the standings.

Repercussions for the Next Match

In the new match, Katía Itzel García will no longer be the fourth official and will assume the role of head referee, while Mohamed will remain on the sidelines as Toluca's coach. This change brings the reunion under greater scrutiny.

Expectations for the Match

With the referee present in the center of the field and Toluca's coach still in the spotlight, the match between Cruz Azul and Toluca promises to be closely watched by fans, who will recall the previous incident.

What's at Stake

Beyond the three points up for grabs, the duel represents another opportunity for both teams to consolidate their positions in the standings, while the personal confrontation between García and Mohamed could influence the game's dynamic.

With information from Infobae.
